tools.name: wayback
tools.description: Closest archived snapshot of a URL to a date, or a monthly list of snapshots (Internet Archive). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: seo_audit
tools.description: On-page SEO check of a URL: title, description, canonical, robots, hreflang, Open Graph, structured data, headings, image alt text, redirects, word count and a list of issues. (cost: 2 credits)

tools.name: wikidata_lookup
tools.description: Structured facts for a company, person or place from Wikidata (headquarters, founded, CEO, website, employees, identifiers, coordinates). (cost: 1 credit)
